correctness.rationale: The mod-3 square is nonzero indicator, so d_i=b_{i-r}; sum around any period gives Z divisible by 3 and at least one zero per complete 0->1->2 circuit, leaving only Z=3 and Z=6 for m<=9. The one-circuit support forces m=4. Remaining 77 six-run compositions at lengths 8,9 are exhaustively testable. An independently written literal enumeration over all 3^m primitive words and m lag residues for m=1..9 produced only (1,0):1,(4,2):4,(4,3):4,(9,4):9,(9,6):9. Thus arbitrary k reduces rigorously to residues.
